svg.text: KNX-DALI Gateway 0.96" OLED Screens — V1/V2 (128x64 Landscape) vs V3 (64x128 Portrait)
Compiled from gateway/src/device/OledDisplay.cpp | Dot-and-Bar Pagination | 2-Line IP on V3 | Right-Aligned Info Col 2
Page 1 — No WiFi Connected (Inline 'NO WIFI: HOLD FUNC 5S' + 0 Errors)
Page 3 — Recent Error Log (5x7 Header + Dense 3x5 Body, Newest First)
Page 4 — Device Info (KNX, ON, PWR W, BUS mA, Uptime)
Auto-Wake Modal — WiFi Setup Portal Active (After Holding FUNC 5s)
Auto-Wake Modal — KNX Programming Mode (Max KNX: 15.15.255)
Auto-Wake Modal — DALI Bus Short Latched Off
